title: Parallel tool execution drops tool_result for calls not yet reached when abort fires
before: At the parent ref, parallel tool calls were preflighted sequentially, each allowed call was stored as a deferred function, and the stored entries were later invoked with Promise.all. The deferred function unconditionally called the prepared tool and the post-execution finalizer without rechecking the shared abort signal. If a later preflight aborted the run, a call that had already been prepared but had not yet been invoked could still perform its side effect and invoke the post-execution result hook. The immediate aborted-preparation branch instead emitted an error outcome directly, so entries in one batch could follow inconsistent cancellation paths.
after: The pinned commit adds an abort check at deferred-entry invocation in the parallel executor. When the shared signal is already aborted, the entry skips tool execution and post-execution finalization, synthesizes an error outcome with the text "Operation aborted", emits tool_execution_end for that call, and returns it to the existing ordered result path. The common path then persists a toolResult message for every recorded call. The committed regression scenario therefore has no external write and no extension tool_result hook, while every started call has a matching error end event and an "Operation aborted" toolResult.
diff: The implementation diff adds a nine-line guard inside the deferred prepared-call closure in packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts; the guard creates a finalized aborted outcome, emits its execution-end event, and returns before executePreparedToolCall or finalizeExecutedToolCall. A new 72-line regression test constructs two parallel calls, aborts during the second preflight, and checks side-effect suppression plus complete error-event and tool-result correspondence. The patch does not change sequential execution or the existing break after an immediate aborted preparation.

evidence_units.claim: The supplied bundle bounds issue 9994 to pinned ref afda4d6202cc179f3d7029d50c9e5752c3b3097d with parent 56c6fb33c4972ef8bb2f4f829518d5d9a7fa24a1, records the issue title, and lists exactly the agent-loop implementation change plus the new regression test; GitHub discussion metadata is unavailable.
The pinned commit is an implementation-bearing fix titled "stop prepared tools after preflight abort"; its commit body references fixes #8935 and the commit subject references #8936.

At the parent, executeToolCallsParallel stored a prepared call as an async deferred entry whose body immediately called executePreparedToolCall and finalizeExecutedToolCall, and Promise.all invoked every stored entry without an abort check at invocation time.

The current preparation path treats an abort observed after beforeToolCall as an immediate "Operation aborted" outcome; the parallel loop emits its end event, records it, and breaks after the aborted preparation.

The pinned implementation rechecks signal.aborted inside each deferred prepared-call entry, constructs an error FinalizedToolCallOutcome with "Operation aborted", emits tool_execution_end, and returns before tool execution or finalization.
evidence_units.source: packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts:520-541 at afda4d6202cc179f3d7029d50c9e5752c3b3097d; git diff 56c6fb33c4972ef8bb2f4f829518d5d9a7fa24a1 afda4d6202cc179f3d7029d50c9e5752c3b3097d -- packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts

evidence_units.claim: After deferred outcomes resolve, the parallel executor creates and emits a tool-result message for each finalized outcome in source order and uses those outcomes for batch termination.

The main loop routes non-length assistant tool-call batches through executeToolCalls, which selects parallel execution unless sequential mode or a sequential tool requires otherwise; the Agent wrapper passes the run signal, tool execution mode, before hook, and after hook into that loop.

AgentSession binds the agent beforeToolCall hook to the extension tool_call event and the afterToolCall hook to the extension tool_result event, so skipping finalization also skips the extension result hook.

An Agent run owns an AbortController, passes its signal into runAgentLoop, and exposes abort through the active run; the deferred guard and preflight therefore observe the same run-level cancellation state.

The regression test creates an external-write tool, sends two tool calls in one assistant tool-use response, records preflights and executions, and aborts the run from the second tool_call extension handler while recording tool_result hooks.

The regression test asserts both preflights occurred in order, no tool execution or result hook occurred, two start events have two matching error end events, and two source-ordered toolResult messages both contain "Operation aborted".
